decisive_items: Shows temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia
response.rationale: The tachycardia persists despite adenosine-induced AV block, indicating an atrial origin. The atrial cycle length of 220 ms (~273 bpm) is consistent with atrial tachycardia/flutter. In contrast, orthodromic AVRT would terminate with adenosine due to AV nodal block.

rejected.why: Orthodromic AVRT would be terminated by adenosine because the AV node is part of the reentrant circuit; here the tachycardia continues after AV block, ruling out this diagnosis.
